title: Cartwise+ Membership Household Members: Adding and Removing
content:
**Rule.** Only Cartwise+ Membership plans with more than 1 household seat share benefits, and only while the membership is trialing or active. A member may be added only while the count of active household members — the people added to this membership and not later removed, plus 1 for the holder — is below the plan's seats. The added person must have their own customer profile, be at least the plan's minimum household-member age, and must not hold a Cartwise+ membership of their own that is not canceled; holding one blocks the addition. A person removed from this membership cannot be added back until the plan's re-add cooldown in calendar days after the removal date has passed. Removals in one paid period are limited to the plan's removals per period, counted as the member removals on this membership dated from the current period start through today.

**What is shared.** Household members share free delivery, the member service-fee rate and credit earning (credited to the holder's balance); Priority Delivery upgrades and credit redemption remain with the holder.

## Adding a member — checks

| Check | Evidence |
|---|---|
| The plan has more than 1 seat | the plan held and its household terms |
| Membership is trialing or active | status on the membership record |
| Active household count (holder included) below the seats | member-added and member-removed entries on the membership |
| Person has their own customer profile and meets the minimum age | the person's customer profile |
| Person holds no Cartwise+ membership of their own that is not canceled | the person's membership records |
| Re-add cooldown after any earlier removal from this membership has passed | member-removed entries for that person |

## Seat count illustrated (hypothetical, 5 seats)

| People added and not removed | Active count with the holder | Another member may be added? |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 4 | yes |
| 4 | 5 | no |

## Benefit sharing

| Benefit | Household member | Holder |
|---|---|---|
| Free delivery | shared | yes |
| Member service-fee rate | shared | yes |
| Credit earning | shared, credited to the holder's balance | yes |
| Priority Delivery upgrades | no | yes |
| Credit redemption | no | yes |
